title: Second-page coproduct comparison for lower-truncated direct image mono
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $E_i\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] have an ambient coproduct cofan $\iota_i:E_i\to S$ in $D(\mathcal O_X)$. Using canonical lower truncation [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], for every $a,r\in\mathbb Z$ and $p\in\mathbb N$, with $Rf_*$ as in [def-pc-derived-direct-image], the canonical map $\bigoplus_i H^p(Rf_*(H^r(\tau_{\ge a}E_i)[0]))\to H^p(Rf_*(H^r(\tau_{\ge a}S)[0]))$ induced by $H^r(\tau_{\ge a}\iota_i)$ is a monomorphism.

source.place: Second-page injectivity; agent-written projection argument, using Tag 009E (5)

proof.text: The composite functor F of truncation, cohomology, and derived direct image on degree-zero modules is additive. From the ambient coproduct universal property construct pi_i, identity on summand i and zero on the others. Functoriality makes F(pi_i) composed with the displayed comparison the i-th coproduct projection.

Identify every stalk of the source coproduct with the direct sum of the stalks using lem-pc-stalk-direct-sums. A vector killed by the comparison has all components zero, by applying the F(pi_i) stalk maps, hence is zero. Stalkwise injectivity gives a monomorphism by sheaf separation. Empty families have zero source, singleton comparisons are images of isomorphisms, and r < a gives zero cohomology.

proof_origin.place: Agent-written additive projection and stalk argument, Tag 009E (5); independently read by X3

mathlib_searches.query: The comparison from a direct sum to the image of a direct sum under an additive functor is a monomorphism in a Grothendieck abelian category
An additive functor into sheaves of modules induces an injective coproduct comparison, because coproduct projections detect every stalk component

theorem truncated_directImage_secondPage_coproduct_mono
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : Type u) (E : I → schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (S : schemeDerivedCategory X) (ι : ∀ i, (E i).obj ⟶ S)
    (hc : IsColimit (Cofan.mk S ι)) (a : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : ℤ) :
    Mono (Sigma.desc (fun i ↦ (schemeModuleHigherDirectImage f (p : ℤ)).map
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) r).map
          ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE a).map (ι i)))))
